Messages.Author: Mochuda
Messages.Body:
A quick hello from France just to ask a tricky question to my eyes

when playing "Toreador Grand Ball" you have to chose a Toreador who doesn't
untap anymore during your untap phase. But if I choose Masika that has the
special abilty to untap freely between 2 M's turns, does he keep this
special ability and can untap between others' turns or can't he untap at all
?

thanx

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
On Mon, 13 Mar 2000, Mochuda wrote:
> when playing "Toreador Grand Ball" you have to chose a Toreador who doesn't
> untap anymore during your untap phase. But if I choose Masika that has the
> special abilty to untap freely between 2 M's turns, does he keep this
> special ability and can untap between others' turns or can't he untap at all
> ?

TGB only prevents untaps during the untap phase. So Masika is fine to
untap at any other point. Alexandra could also untap a vampire at another
point, as could cards like Rutor's Hand, Metro Underground, Homunculus and
so forth. It's only the untap phase which is stopped.

--

James Coupe

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Correct.
And it's only the "as normal" untap during the untap phase that is
stopped. Other untaps during the phase (via Homunculus or Derange
or whatever) are not stopped.
